_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.43.0: adds `? table`, which finds every join chain between two tables (not just the direct next hop), ranked by how much of a real ownership relationship each route stays within. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.58.0, which adds the matching canvas-mode 'path' action and Pine-editor autocomplete for that search, a join-type (Inner/Left/Right) picker, click-to-edit chips, Shift+J/Shift+K pipeline navigation, and several canvas focus/hover fixes.
